ZhongWen Snap for Windows 11

1. Place ZhongWenSnap.exe in a permanent folder and double-click it.
2. In Settings, enter an OpenAI API key and save.
   Create a key at https://platform.openai.com/api-keys
3. Press Ctrl+Alt+T, then drag around the text you want to translate.
4. Right-click the green system tray icon to change the hotkey, model, prompt, or startup setting.
5. Click Ask in a translation popup to ask about its text or grammar.
   Enter sends; Shift+Enter adds a newline. Keep asking for clarification.
   Reset chat starts over. Closing the popup discards the chat; it is not saved to History.

An internet connection and separately billed OpenAI API access are required.
Exit any earlier version from the system tray before starting this one.
The EXE is unsigned, so Windows may ask you to review it before first run.
